summary: Planner fingerprints, policy ASK roles, and session holds are projections into one durable gate protocol, never independent approval authorities.
Gate-open seals the exact consequence and versioned policy, identity, authority, budget, evidence, topology, and resource-head dependencies.
An authenticated principal- and role-bound decision is evidence for fresh 036 evaluation, not a Boolean bearer capability.
Open, claim, decide, revalidate, append, and resume form an append-only CAS- and fence-guarded state machine with explicit terminal successors.
Only atomic dependency revalidation followed by 036 authorization and fenced append may release the exact consequence.
Exact retries return receipts, conflicting replays fail, approvals are single-use, and timeout/cancel are version-bound system transitions.
Gate enforcement belongs on the compiled consequence edge below all executors; files, callbacks, checkpoints, and direct invoke cannot bypass it.
